xmn-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，厦门高崎国际机场（XMN）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
xmn-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Xiamen Gaoqi International Airport (XMN) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

xmn-baidu-1.webp.zh: 厦门高崎机场：一架厦门航空客机在滑行道上，身后是标着「XIAMEN AIRPORT」的航站楼与山脚下的城区。
xmn-baidu-1.webp.en: Xiamen Gaoqi: a XiamenAir jet on the taxiway before the terminal lettered 'XIAMEN AIRPORT', the city crowding the hills behind.

xmn-baidu-2.webp.zh: 一架厦门航空客机即将降落高崎机场，机腹下是车流与写着「高崎机场 Gaoqi Airport」的绿色路牌。
xmn-baidu-2.webp.en: A XiamenAir jet on short final over Gaoqi Airport, above traffic passing a green '高崎机场 Gaoqi Airport' road sign.
